description: acc-sw-1: an access switch whose PortList bitmaps happen to decode as printable text
note: Hand-authored, and the point of it is the spelling rather than the topology. A bitmap of ports 2 and 3 is the single byte 0x60, which is the printable character '`', so collector.snmp.session.decode records it as text rather than as colon-separated hex. A reader that assumed hex would find no members at all. VLAN 30's untagged bitmap also names a port its egress bitmap does not, which an agent should not do and some do.
